stem: Which theme is present in the poem “Sybil Ludington’s Ride”?

options.label: A
options.text: Personal sacrifice is more important than family.

options.label: B
options.text: Trust will always lead to new realizations.

options.label: C
options.text: Confronting danger requires courage and fortitude.

options.label: D
options.text: Accepting one’s fate requires skill and stamina.
